note: P4318 (Pro 28:8) — who multiplies wealth by interest gathers it for one generous to the poor.

dims.v: exploitative greed — piling up wealth by interest and profit
the multiplying of wealth by interest and unjust profit — exploitative greed that grinds the needy, only to gather in the end for the generous who will give it away
set against the kindness to the poor that finally gains it

rabah (multiply/increase) — 'whoever MULTIPLIES his wealth by interest and profit'; amassing by usury is exploitative gain (forbidden, Ex 22:25). Emergent: greed that piles up by grinding the poor — only to lose it to the generous (28:8b), for God overturns unjust gain.
kindness — the generous who inherit the usurer's hoard
the generosity to the poor of the one who, in God's justice, finally gathers in the wealth the usurer amassed — kindness rewarded with what greed loses
the usury that unwittingly serves it (266730)
set against the exploitative amassing that ends in its hands

chanan (be gracious/generous) — 'gathers it for him who is GENEROUS to the poor'; God's justice funnels ill-gotten wealth to the kind. The usurer hoards; the generous inherit. Greed builds for a giver it never meant to enrich (cf 13:22).
